title: GPT 6 Astra (xhigh) genuinely cooks in asset generation 🔥
author: Huge_Coat9691
selftext:
Reference I follow: [https://www.mcp-for-blender.com/creations/case-studies/i-just-wanted-to-fish/](https://www.mcp-for-blender.com/creations/case-studies/i-just-wanted-to-fish/)

1. I use Astra to generate multiple profiles: front, side, and top of the object.  
2. Using these profile images + a reference image of the game (for colour scheme and vibe), I ask Astra to generate assets using Blender MCP.
